records.title: Literature and the Nobel Prize
records.header: GLITS 200 Literature and the Nobel Prize (3) A&H
records.text: GLITS 200 Literature and the Nobel Prize (3) A&H Literature from around the world as seen through the writings of Nobel Prize winners. Features authors from a range of countries, languages, and traditions to explore wide-ranging questions such as: What is literature? Why study literature in global contexts? Who wins, who doesn't, and why? What does that tell us about literature and about the world in which we live? Credit/no-credit only.
